About Us

Built for continuous industrial use

Influitive Automation LLP supplies and installs the full range of industrial doors, shutters, and access automation equipment used across manufacturing plants, cold storage facilities, logistics hubs, and hangars.

From a single loading bay to a complete facility fit-out, we handle specification, installation, and after-sales service so your openings keep working through every shift, every season.

01

Engineering-led

Every installation is specified against the opening, the load, and the operating environment — not sold off a catalogue.

02

End-to-end delivery

Site survey, supply, installation, and commissioning handled by one team, start to finish.

03

Ongoing service support

Scheduled maintenance and breakdown support to keep equipment running with minimal downtime.

What We Do

Our product range

A complete line of industrial doors, shutters, and access equipment, specified and installed for the environment they'll actually run in.

Hangar Doors

Large-span sliding and folding door systems built for aircraft hangars and heavy-clearance openings.

Loading Bay Equipment

Dock levellers, dock shelters, and restraint systems that keep loading and unloading safe and efficient.

High Speed Doors

Rapid-cycle doors engineered for high-traffic openings where speed and thermal separation matter.

Cold Storage Doors

Insulated doors designed to hold temperature and seal tightly across repeated cold-chain cycles.

Rolling Shutters

Slatted roller shutters for warehouses, shopfronts, and factory openings needing a compact rolled-up profile.

Fire Rated Shutters & Doors

Fire-resistant barriers built to compartmentalise risk and hold a rating under real fire conditions.

Industrial Sliding Doors

Heavy-duty sliding panels for wide openings where a swing door isn't practical.

Motorised Gates

Automated sliding and swing gates for perimeter and vehicle-access control points.

Commercial Doors

Entrance and access doors specified for storefronts, offices, and commercial facilities.

Boom Barriers

Automated boom barriers for controlled vehicle entry at gates, plants, and parking facilities.

Bio-Metric Systems

Fingerprint and face-recognition attendance & access terminals for offices, plants, and gated sites.

Door Access Control

Card, PIN, and app-based access control systems for single doors through multi-door facilities.

Fire Alarm Systems

Detection, alarm panel, and sounder installations designed around fire-safety compliance for your site.

CCTV Surveillance

IP and analog camera systems with recording and remote monitoring for round-the-clock site visibility.
